description: Project your weight-loss journey from a daily calorie deficit: weekly rate, weeks to goal, and date.

faqs.a: About 7,700 kcal equals 1 kg of body fat, so a 500 kcal daily deficit yields roughly 0.5 kg per week.
faqs.q: How is the weekly loss calculated?

faqs.a: 0.5–1 kg per week is generally considered sustainable. Faster loss should be supervised by a professional.
faqs.q: What is a safe rate of loss?

faqs.a: Metabolism adapts and water weight fluctuates — treat the timeline as a guide, not a promise.
